csv_scope_of_work: Various Engineering Services (Disciplines) Through Continuing Contracts for Citywide Use Within the City of Hollywood. A. Coastal and Marine Engineering: Seawall evaluation, Seawall repair and construction, marina evaluation, repairs, reconstruction, mooring fields, beach sand nourishment, dune plantings and construction. B. Civil Engineering General: Site work, drainage, park improvements. C. Civil Engineering Roadway: Roadway improvement project survey, planning, design, permitting, bidding, and construction phase services for projects funded by the City, Broward County MPO, MPO, FDOT or FTA or Local Agency Program, Broward County Surtax funded projects and any other funding source that requires the execution of agency specific agreement conditions and reporting. D. Traffic Engineering & Transportation Planning: Traffic calming, traffic signal, warrant studies, planning traffic studies, speed studies, safety improvements as well as reviewing & analyzing development related traffic studies. (Proposers for this work must provide documentation ensuring no conflict of interest with any (past, present and future) Hollywood developer). E. Environmental Engineering: Phase 1, Phase II, RAC, asbestos, mold, monitoring well drilling, sampling, reports, studies, recommendations, design, inspection services. F. Construction Engineering Inspections: Roadway improvement project CEI services for projects funded by the City, Broward County MPO, FDOT or FTA or Local Agency Program, Broward County Surtax funded projects and any other funding source that requires the execution of agency specific agreement conditions, grant compliance and reporting. G. Geotechnical, Surveying General, Materials Testing, GPA & GPRS Locating Services, Envelope, Waterprofing, Special and Threshold Inspection Services: All types. H. Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing Engineering: Facility renovations, repairs, improvements, evaluations, public roadways lighting studies, evaluations and design, 40 year certification. I. Structural Engineering: Facility renovations, repairs, improvements, evaluations, 40 year certification J. Information Technology, Fire Alarm Engineering, Access Control, CCTV: Voice, data, fiber, DAS, access management, CCTV, audio visual, radio system, public safety technology
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Materials Testing, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning

title: Various Engineering Services
short_description: Continuing contracts for multiple citywide engineering disciplines in Hollywood, Florida.
project_scope: Citywide continuing contracts for multiple engineering disciplines within the City of Hollywood. Scope includes coastal and marine works such as seawall evaluation, repair and construction, marina evaluation and reconstruction, mooring fields, beach nourishment, and dune works; general civil engineering for site work, drainage, and park improvements; roadway engineering for surveys, planning, design, permitting, bidding, and construction-phase services; traffic engineering and transportation planning; environmental engineering investigations and remediation-related services; construction engineering inspection; geotechnical, surveying, materials testing, locating, envelope, waterproofing, and special/threshold inspections; MEP engineering; structural engineering for facility renovations, repairs, improvements, evaluations, and 40-year certification; and IT/fire alarm/access control/CCTV engineering. No specific building size, bridge span, or single project technical parameters are defined because this is a citywide continuing-services procurement.
services: Continuing engineering services contracts covering civil, roadway, traffic, transportation planning, coastal/marine, environmental, CEI, geotechnical, surveying, materials testing, MEP, structural engineering, and related inspection services.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style continuing contracts for broad citywide services without a defined structural project.
- Includes many disciplines outside sbp's core focus, such as MEP, environmental, traffic, IT, and inspections.
- Structural engineering scope is limited to facility renovations, repairs, evaluations, and certifications, with no notable special structures or long spans.
- No specific bridge, stadium, roof, cultural building, or architecturally demanding structure is identified.
- The brief explicitly resembles a multi-discipline framework agreement, which is generally low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents as contract value for the continuing contracts; this appears to be total contract capacity, not a single project's construction cost.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee for structural or bridge engineering is stated. The document only gives an overall contract value of 7.5 million USD for multiple continuing contracts across many disciplines.
references_qualifications: Proposers must be qualified in the requested disciplines. For traffic engineering and transportation planning, proposers must provide documentation ensuring no conflict of interest with any past, present, or future Hollywood developer. No detailed minimum reference counts or project-specific qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: City of Hollywood (Purchasing Department), Hollywood, Florida, USA. Contact: Ramses Terrero. Phone: 754-314-0154. Fax: 954-921-3416. Email: rterrero@hollywoodfl.org. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/hollywoodfl/projects/261121
notes: RFQ No. RFQ-402-26-GJ-. Multiple contracts may be awarded. Contract duration: base period 36 months with 24-month renewal option; renewable. Questions deadline: 2026-07-01 05:00 AM EDT. Although structural engineering is included, this is a broad continuing-services procurement rather than a defined building or bridge project. Category assigned as Buildings because the structural scope mainly concerns facility renovations and evaluations.
